turns.user: I activated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00 and transferred at 10:28.
turns.agent:
Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, your transfer at 10:28 is within the 30-minute ticket’s transfer window. Validate the ticket when changing to another line. If that was your final transfer, you may finish that last ride even if it continues beyond 10:30; the window is not a deadline to get off. If you transfer again after 10:30, that later transfer would be outside the stated window.

This applies to covered lines and the ticket’s applicable area; the snapshot doesn’t establish coverage for every route. BKK: 30-minute ticket. I’m an independent demo, not affiliated with BKK; check the official page for current rules.

turns.user: My last bus arrives at 10:48. Can I stay on that bus until the stop?
turns.agent:
Yes—if the 10:28 transfer was your final transfer and you validated the mobile ticket when boarding/changing lines. The snapshot says you may complete that last ride after the 30-minute window ends, so arriving at 10:48 is okay; 10:30 is not a get-off deadline.

This assumes the bus and journey are covered by the ticket’s applicable rules. BKK: 30-minute ticket. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not live verification; check BKK’s current guidance.
